name: Sandloop
description:
About This Game

In the lands of Iman, a festival is held every year. During the celebrations, a special ceremony takes place where the young are given important clothes and the Mindil —magical cloths that hide long-forgotten powers. 

This year, it is Hura’s turn, but her experience will be very different from the ones before. Strangers attack the village, trying to steal an ancient power. In the middle of the chaos, Hura escapes and finds a loom that gives her magical powers through her new clothes. 

With the blessing of the tribe’s elder, she sets out on a journey to learn new abilities, stop the invaders, and uncover a mystery that weaves itself with every jump.

  • A retro-style 3D platformer with controls modernized to today's standards.

  • Special abilities that let you move gracefully and fluidly across the map.

  • A fantasy story with a moral to unravel.

  • Various mini-games to enjoy and earn coins.

Explore Iman

Discover a map divided into four unique, interconnected zones where you'll face challenges and uncover new abilities to enhance your moveset.

Upgrade your Mindil

Unlock various skills by exploring the world. Theses abilities will improve your mobility and grant acces to new, previously unreachable areas.

Find ancient magic to boost your powers

Hidden throughout the map are fragments of stamina and health. Collect them to increase Hura's edurance and perform special abilities more frequently.

Optimize your time

The magical lands of Iman are trapped in a time loop. Stop the invaders before the day resets and seize the power of time.

Customize your appearance

Acquire new outfits to change Hura's look

Help the locals

During your adventure, you'll encounter some of Iman's inhabitants who will need your help.
short_desc: Help Hura save her village from invaders by exploring the intricate lands of Iman and gaining ancient skills that will enhance her mobility!
